purpose: Combat BiS / power armour sets with regional acquisition for Equilibrium: malevolent / tectonic / sirenic craft, elite T92 upgrades, trimmed + custom-fit masterwork, Cryptbloom, GWD2 anima core + refined, Vestments of havoc, Nex T80 residual geography, necro deathdealer/deathwarden residual, Achto residual. 16 equipment rows. Skip all ids already first-class in data/research/regional-combat-unlocks.json.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. required_regions lists hard elective-region gates for normal self-supply. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global tokens in region_hint. Long craft chains with tradeable mats or alternate shops use region_hints + region_pressure instead of forcing all_required.
policy.duplicate_guard: SKIP already first-class in regional-combat-unlocks.json: achievements:*, anachronia:*, dungeoneering:*, morytania:berserkers-fury-relic, morytania:heightened-senses-relic, cross-region:death-ward-relic, morytania:vyre-combat-infrastructure, salve-amulet:enchanted, morytania:amulet-of-forsaken-berserkers-fury, cross-region:igneous-zuk-capes, farm-perk:*, mage-arena:guthix-staff, dominion-tower:dreadnips, rum-deal:holy-wrench, broken-home:asylum-surgeons-ring, karamja:*, forinthry:corporeal-beast-holy-elixir, cross-region:blessed-flask.
policy.no_trade_rule: No-trade League builds make boss-drop energy / scales / essence real region pressure even when pieces are GE-tradeable in the main game. Record normal self-supply geography, not GE short-circuits.
policy.external_area_rule: Mazcab (Achto / Liberation of Mazcab) = desert. Arc / Seiryu / Temple of Aminishi / seasinger = asgarnia (user rule 2026-07-26; Desert Ports pressure optional later).
policy.boss_strategy_rule: Record armour set acquisition and region pressure only — not kill strategies.

equipment_additions.name: Malevolent armour (T90 melee power craft)
equipment_additions.category: BiS power armour craft / T90 melee
requirements: 90 Defence to wear
91–93 Smithing to craft helm/greaves/cuirass (assistable)
Malevolent energy from Barrows – Rise of the Six
Reinforcing plates (shop: Saro in Keldagrim or Bandit Duty Free)
effects: Tier 90 melee power armour (helm, cuirass, greaves)
Degrades to dust after 100,000 combat charges unless dyed (dyed degrades to broken and repairs with malevolent energy)
Full set dismantles into malevolent essence on a dragonkin anvil for masterwork armour trim
region_pressure: Morytania hard-owns RoTS malevolent energy — the defining self-supply gate for the set and for malevolent essence used in trimmed masterwork.
Reinforcing plates are coin-shop items (Keldagrim Fremennik pressure or Bandit Duty Free Forinthry), not a second hard region lock.
equipment_additions.notes: Still the T90 melee power baseline before trimmed masterwork. Invention augmentation of body/legs is the usual long-term path. Do not treat plates as a Fremennik hard gate.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania for normal RoTS energy self-supply. Quest auto-complete does not replace the boss drop region.

equipment_additions.name: Tectonic robe armour (T90 magic power craft)
equipment_additions.category: BiS power armour craft / T90 magic
requirements: 90 Defence to wear
91–93 Runecrafting to craft mask/bottom/top (assistable)
Tectonic energy from Vorago
Stones of binding (Wizard's Guild or Bandit Duty Free)
effects: Tier 90 magic power armour
Set bonus Fracture Point: +1% critical strike chance per piece worn (2025 set-bonus pass)
Base pieces for elite tectonic upgrade when at high charge
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard-owns Vorago / borehole tectonic energy self-supply.
Stones of binding are coin shops (Wizard's Guild Kandarin or Bandit Duty Free Forinthry) — support pressure only.
equipment_additions.notes: Primary magic power T90 before elite tectonic or Tumeken's resplendence. Crit-chance set bonus makes full tectonic pieces more attractive post-2025 than pure tank swaps for power setups.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia for Vorago energy. Keep shop plates/stones as soft pressure only.

equipment_additions.name: Sirenic armour (T90 ranged power craft)
equipment_additions.category: BiS power armour craft / T90 ranged
requirements: 90 Defence to wear
91–93 Crafting to craft mask/chaps/hauberk (assistable)
Sirenic scales from many high-level monsters (distributed drop table)
Algarum thread (Ocellus at Monastery of Ascension or Bandit Duty Free)
effects: Tier 90 ranged power armour
Set bonus Chromatic Choir: while wielding a crossbow, chance to proc enchanted bolt effects (Dragonstone at 2pc; Dragonstone/Onyx/Hydrix at 3pc)
Base pieces for elite sirenic upgrade
region_pressure: Kandarin: Ocellus is the practical non-Wilderness algarum-thread shop at the Monastery of Ascension.
Morytania: Araxxor/Araxxi is a strong high-rate sirenic-scale self-supply boss among many drop sources.
Forinthry: Bandit Duty Free is the alternate thread shop; Wilderness high-level content can also drop scales.
No single elective region monopolises sirenic scales — do not mark one region all_required.
equipment_additions.notes: Unlike malevolent/tectonic, sirenic is intentionally multi-source. Planner should show scale + thread pressure, not a fake single-region hard lock. Dracolich is the competing non-degrade T90 ranged path (Misthalin Vorkath).
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Surface Kandarin shop + multi-boss scale pressure. Re-evaluate if Equilibrium grants thread or concentrates scale drops.

equipment_additions.name: Elite tectonic robe armour (T92 magic power)
equipment_additions.category: BiS power armour craft / T92 magic
requirements: 92 Defence to wear
Tectonic armour pieces at high charge (from Vorago energy — Asgarnia)
Draconic energy (Black Stone Dragon / Dragonkin Laboratory elite chests / rare Rex Matriarchs)
Praesulic essence (magic) from breaking down Virtus equipment at a dragonkin anvil (99 Runecrafting to create essence from scratch)
Stones of binding; chaotic remnant (Daemonheim rewards, untradeable) for the robe top
effects: Tier 92 magic power armour
Elite Fracture Point: +2% critical strike chance per piece
No charge use inside Elite Dungeons or Sanctum of Rebirth
Repaired with elite tectonic repair patches rather than raw energy
region_pressure: Asgarnia: tectonic base (Vorago) + Virtus/Nex praesulic essence chain.
Forinthry: Dragonkin Laboratory / Wilderness ED self-supply for draconic energy (repo major-upgrades geography); Daemonheim chaotic remnant.
Kandarin: optional stones-of-binding shop convenience only.
equipment_additions.notes: Distinct from base tectonic: elite adds Forinthry ED2 energy + Asgarnia Nex Virtus dismantle. Do not collapse into a single-region Vorago row.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: All-required Asgarnia + Forinthry for normal self-supply of base tectonic and draconic energy. GE-era trade does not apply in no-trade League.

equipment_additions.name: Elite sirenic armour (T92 ranged power)
equipment_additions.category: BiS power armour craft / T92 ranged
requirements: 92 Defence to wear
Sirenic armour pieces at high charge
Ancient scales (Seiryu / Temple of Aminishi primary; elite chests; rare Rex Matriarchs)
Praesulic essence (ranged) from dismantling Pernix at a dragonkin anvil (99 Crafting to create from scratch)
Algarum thread; chaotic spikes (Daemonheim rewards) for the hauberk
effects: Tier 92 ranged power armour
Elite Chromatic Choir: doubled bolt-proc chances vs base sirenic while wielding a crossbow
No charge use inside Elite Dungeons or Sanctum of Rebirth
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard-owns Nex Pernix for praesulic essence (ranged) when self-sourcing from scratch.
Kandarin / Forinthry: algarum thread shops + sirenic base materials pressure.
Forinthry: Shadow Reef / Daemonheim ED infrastructure and chaotic spikes; secondary ancient-scale routes via elite chests.
Asgarnia owns Temple of Aminishi / Seiryu (Arc packaging) for primary ancient-scale self-supply; secondary scales via elite chests / Rex residual.
equipment_additions.notes: Asgarnia owns Nex Pernix essence + Arc ED1/Seiryu ancient-scale path under Equilibrium Arc=Asgarnia packaging. Secondary scale routes remain elite chests / Rex residual.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Asgarnia for Pernix essence and primary ancient scales (Seiryu / ED1). Revisit only if Equilibrium splits Arc electives.

equipment_additions.name: Trimmed masterwork melee armour (T92)
equipment_additions.category: BiS power armour craft / T92 melee
requirements: 92 Defence to wear; 99 Smithing and It Should Have Been Called Aetherium to create
Masterwork melee base set (glorious-bar / masterwork rivet Smithing chain)
Masterwork melee armour trim: elder rune bar + malevolent essence + praesulic essence (melee) per trim
Malevolent essence from dismantling malevolent armour (RoTS energy)
Praesulic essence (melee) from dismantling Torva (Nex)
Twelve trims for a full set
effects: Tier 92 melee power armour with gloves and boots (full five-piece set)
Damage-delay set behaviour that softens incoming hits (paired against Vestments glass-cannon play)
No charge use inside Elite Dungeons or Sanctum of Rebirth
Cannot be dyed; repaired by consuming unused untrimmed masterwork pieces at an anvil
region_pressure: Asgarnia: Nex Torva for praesulic essence (melee); Artisans' Workshop is the practical masterwork smithing home.
Morytania: malevolent energy → malevolent armour → malevolent essence for every trim.

Kandarin: dragonkin anvil in the Ancient Cavern (dragon forge) is the wiki dismantle site for malevolent essence — access pressure, not a third hard elective if other anvils/paths exist in League overlays.
equipment_additions.notes: Melee T92 equivalent of elite tectonic/sirenic. Full trim is a genuine dual-region self-supply chain (Nex + RoTS). Keep separate from the custom-fit row.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: All-required Asgarnia + Morytania for Torva and malevolent essence self-supply.

equipment_additions.name: Custom-fit trimmed masterwork (Elof / Master Crafter)
equipment_additions.category: BiS armour permanent upgrade / T92 masterwork
requirements: Full masterwork set equipped (melee trimmed, or masterwork magic / masterwork ranged variants)
Speak to Elof in Artisans' Workshop (melee custom-fit / spiked) or the Master Crafter (magic/ranged custom-fit paths)
Process is irreversible and makes the set permanently untradeable
effects: Doubles max charges from 100,000 to 200,000 (halves degradation rate)
Never degrades or loses charge when hit by the current Slayer task, Reaper task, or Elite Dungeon monster/miniboss/boss target
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard-owns the custom-fit NPCs (Elof at Falador Artisans' Workshop; Master Crafter at the Crafting Guild).
Morytania remains upstream pressure only because melee custom-fit assumes trimmed masterwork (malevolent essence) already exists.
equipment_additions.notes: Custom-fit is a separate region-planning unlock from crafting the armour. Spiked melee variants are cosmetic (glorious bar per piece at Elof). Magic custom-fit and ranged custom-fit (2025–2026 masterwork armour expansions) share the same Asgarnia NPC geography.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia for the custom-fit service even if the set was obtained via other routes.

equipment_additions.name: Cryptbloom armour (T90 magic tank)
requirements: 90 Defence to wear
Incomplete Cryptbloom pieces dropped by Croesus (Elder God Wars Dungeon)
Croesus flakes to restore incomplete pieces and to repair
effects: Tier 90 magic tank armour (full five-piece set including gloves and boots)
Nature's Envoy set bonus: stacking magic/melee damage reduction; deathspore chance at 4pc; Fungal Shield at 5pc below 20% LP
Stacks with Animate Dead and innate tank reduction
region_pressure: Misthalin hard-owns Croesus / EGWD Croesus Front under current Catalyst→Equilibrium working taxonomy for EGWD.
equipment_additions.notes: Primary high-end magic tank alternative to Achto Primeval. Gloves/boots often swapped for cinderbanes / Kerapac wraps / blast diffusion in power hybrids — still index the full set acquisition region.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Misthalin while EGWD remains filed under Misthalin. Re-map only if Equilibrium relocates Croesus.

equipment_additions.name: Anima core armour (GWD2 T80 power)
requirements: 80 Defence to wear
Dormant anima core pieces + Crest of Zaros / Zamorak / Seren / Sliske from Heart of Gielinor (GWD2)
Combine dormant core with the matching crest
effects: Style-split T80 power sets: Zaros melee, Zamorak ranged, Seren magic, hybrid Sliske
Non-degrading base anima core (no prayer or LP bonuses unlike Torva family)
Stats comparable to Nex T80 power armour without Nex access
region_pressure: Desert hard-owns Heart of Gielinor / GWD2 crests and dormant cores.
equipment_additions.notes: Strong League bridge set when Desert is unlocked before Asgarnia Nex. 2026 GWD2 change: best drop rates available immediately; reputation no longer gates drop rates (cap 2,000).

equipment_additions.name: Refined anima core armour (GWD2)
requirements: Base anima core piece of the matching style
Serenic, Sliskean, Zamorakian, and Zarosian essences (1/2/3 of each for helm/legs/body)
Unlock refined craft by earning 750 reputation with the matching GWD2 faction (e.g. Zarosian for refined Zaros)
effects: Upgraded anima core stats (still style-split power armour)
Degrades after 100,000 charges back to unrefined; re-refine with more essences
Body and legs augmentable
region_pressure: Desert hard-owns all four essence types and the reputation unlocks inside Heart of Gielinor.
equipment_additions.notes: Refined is a pure Desert continuation of anima core — no second elective region. Useful when GWD2 is the only high combat region online.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert. Reputation unlocks stay Desert-local.

equipment_additions.name: Vestments of havoc (T95 melee glass cannon)
equipment_additions.category: BiS power armour drop / T95 melee
requirements: 95 Defence to wear
Rare drops from Zamorak, Lord of Chaos (Elite Dungeon 4 — The Zamorakian Undercity)
effects: Mixed tier: ~T110 damage bonus with ~T75 power armour rating (glass cannon)
Herald of Chaos: post-melee-ultimate adrenaline regen (2pc); +6s Berserk duration (3pc); +20% max adrenaline with melee weapon (4pc)
Does not degrade; top and bottom augmentable at T95 divine-charge drain
One piece prevents aggression from Zamorak followers in God Wars Dungeon
region_pressure: Wiki Equilibrium League area tag places Zamorak, Lord of Chaos under Misthalin (Senntisten / Undercity access taxonomy).
Forinthry optional: Wilderness crater / portal geography and ED wilderness adjacency — do not double-count as all_required until Equilibrium publishes a boundary different from the wiki League tag.
equipment_additions.notes: Melee BiS damage armour competing with custom-fit trimmed masterwork. Prefer 3-piece Berserk extension in many rotations; 4-piece is situational adrenaline-cap play. Not a craft set — pure boss drop.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Treat Misthalin as the current wiki League region for Zamorak. Re-verify if Equilibrium reveals reassign the Undercity to Forinthry.

equipment_additions.name: Nex T80 power armour residual (Torva / Pernix / Virtus)
requirements: 80 Defence (and style levels) to wear
Torva (melee), Pernix (ranged), Virtus (magic) drops from Nex in God Wars Dungeon
effects: Tier 80 style power armour with life-point and prayer bonuses on the classic Nex sets
Primary source of praesulic essence when dismantled for T92 elite tectonic / elite sirenic / trimmed masterwork
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard-owns Nex inside GWD1.
equipment_additions.notes: Residual as worn BiS (superseded by T90/T92 power), but still region-critical as the essence feedstock for all three T92 power crafts. Angel of Death is a separate Asgarnia weapon/prayer chain.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia. Keep essence-feedstock role visible even when worn BiS has moved on.

equipment_additions.name: Deathdealer robe armour (necro power residual)
requirements: City of Um / Underworld Necromancy progression (working League taxonomy: Misthalin)
Kili equipment-upgrade tasks for each tier unlock
Craft at the soul forge in the Um smithy from deathwarden base + ensouled cloth/thread + necrotic runes
Must craft a piece at least once to wear it
effects: Necromancy power armour at tiers 70 / 80 / 90
Set bonus: per-piece chance to apply Death Mark on necromancy hits (1% / 1.5% / 2% per piece by tier; 5% / 7.5% / 10% at five pieces)
region_pressure: Misthalin hard-owns City of Um infrastructure (soul forge, Kili, rituals) under Catalyst→Equilibrium working taxonomy.
equipment_additions.notes: Residual vs newer necro hybrid gear but still the style-native power ladder. Augmented tops/bottoms keep perks when tier-upgrading.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Misthalin while City of Um stays Misthalin-mapped.

equipment_additions.name: Deathwarden robe armour (necro tank residual)
requirements: City of Um Necromancy progression
Tier ladder from low-tier deathwarden through T90 via soul forge upgrades
Kili tasks for higher-tier craft/wear unlocks
effects: Necromancy tank armour across tiers 10–90
Higher-tier set bonuses grant dodge chance (tank counterpart to deathdealer Death Mark)
T60 deathwarden is the craft base that upgrades into deathdealer power robes
region_pressure: Misthalin / City of Um same hard geography as deathdealer.
equipment_additions.notes: Residual tank path for necro; still the mandatory early craft spine before deathdealer. Do not treat as Misthalin-optional.

equipment_additions.name: Achto raids armour residual (Mazcab)
requirements: Liberation of Mazcab raids (Beastmaster Durzag / Yakamaru)
Normal Primeval / Tempest / Teralith purchasable with teci; Achto superior is rare boss drop
Achto piece order is gated (must collect earlier Achto slots across styles before later body slots)
effects: Tier 90 tank sets per style (Primeval magic, Tempest ranged, Teralith melee)
Achto set: off-hand shield damage contribution scaling with pieces; chance to reset defensive ability cooldowns when damaged at 3+ pieces
Does not degrade inside Raids; degrades outside and repairs for coins / POH armour stand
region_pressure: Desert owns Liberation of Mazcab / Achto under Equilibrium Mazcab=Desert mapping.
Cryptbloom (Misthalin Croesus) remains the elective-region magic-tank alternative path.
equipment_additions.notes: Achto tank sets from Liberation of Mazcab. Hard Desert under Equilibrium Mazcab=Desert mapping. Prefer Cryptbloom / refined anima / style tanks when Desert is not unlocked.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Desert. Mazcab residual maps to Desert elective.

equipment_additions.name: Turtling perk residual (tank gizmo)
requirements: Invention unlocked and armour gizmos available
Turtling perk materials / gizmo combinations (Historic components appear in high-rank turtling combos)
effects: Armour gizmo perk that improves defensive ability uptime / barrier-style tank play
Still used on tank shells (Cryptbloom, Achto, refined anima) rather than as a worn armour set
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard-owns Invention Guild infrastructure for gizmo work in the normal self-supply path.
Misthalin optional: Archaeology Historic component supply for high-rank Turtling combinations.
equipment_additions.notes: Not a worn armour set — residual tank-support perk called out because BiS tank shells still socket Turtling. Do not present Asgarnia as mandatory solely for Turtling if League grants Invention globally; keep as normal infrastructure geography.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Asgarnia for Invention Guild unless Equilibrium globalises Invention tutorial/machines.
